## Big Win component
- **Status:** Optional
- **Type:** Factory Binding `Injects.ComponentsFactory` > `Injects.BigWin`

### Description
The big win component is a popup to be shown when the player wins an amount greater than their stake * a set multiplier value. The multiplier defaults to 15 but can be changed via the BasePackage Config via `BigWinStakeMultiplier` (see the `IEngineConfig` interface).

By default:
- shows at the end of a game if the win is over *BigWinStakeMultiplier*, Specifically shown by the `Cabinet.endGame` call.
- prevents the player buying in while on screen

> :warning: **Not automatically bound so must be done manually if required, ideally through the ComponentsFactory to ensure it's bound after the relevant asset loading has completed. If left unbound no popup will show.**

### API
#### init(): void
Creates any internal parts, can access loaded assets at this point

Called:
- after bindings
- after bootstrap
- after Vues are mounted
- after PIXI initilisation
- before gameApp.init

#### resize(width: number, height: number): void
Required to be called in GameApplication. Intended to be called on every `GLOBAL.ORIENTATION_CHANGE` event.

#### showBigWin(): Promise<void>
Called in `Cabinet.endGame()`, expected to return a promise that resolves once the HTP is closed

### BareBones Example
This is a super barebones example which doesn't implement any functionality typically seen in Tombola games but will compile out of the box.
```ts
// file big-win.ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { IBigWinBase } from './big-win';

export class BigWin extends Container implements IBigWinBase {
    public init(): void {
    }

    public resize(width: number, height: number): void {
    }

    public async showBigWin(): Promise<void> {
        console.warn('showBigWin() called without implmentation');
    }
}
```
